head: codex/5748-terminal-recovery
title: [v0.91.8][csdlc-v2][closeout] Recover remaining closed-issue terminal truth
body:
Closes #5748

## Summary
- reconcile every live GitHub-closed v0.91.8 issue to authenticated typed C-SDLC v2 terminal truth
- retain claim-free closed_out projections and complete receipts for all 114 issues in the pre-publication universe
- add typed receipt transport, recordless and corrupt historical recovery, authenticated issue-to-PR linkage, and non-destructive prune classification
- harden terminal storage and audit generation against stale authority, unsafe paths, symlinks, partial writes, missing review, and failed required checks

## Validation
- complete C-SDLC v2 test suite, strict all-target Clippy, formatting, and diff hygiene: PASS at Rust source f6d0cbab2
- exact executable audit scripts at 05209b1a0: 114 live issues, 111 issue-specific packets, 108 unique PRs, path-guard PASS, zero exceptions
- installed v2 provenance, coexistence, #5748 doctor, live-universe parity, and terminal inventory: PASS at publication head

## Review
- independent exact-head review at bce72abad returned PASS with no actionable findings
- the publication metadata descendant is accepted by the typed automatic metadata-only review guard

No worktree was pruned, no dirty evidence was deleted, and no AWS or Spot activity was used. Typed closeout remains a separate post-merge operation.
